svg.text: STAGE 518 · TOPIC 158 · P1029–P1030 🎉 · SVG 162 · 160th FAQ 🎉 · 🎉 HISTORIC 85th ROUND, P1030, 160th FAQ & 960-TEST MILESTONE!
WebRTC/RTP RFC 7022 / RFC 3550 RTCP SDES CNAME Ephemeral Privacy & Non-CNAME PII Strip Guard
⛔ Vulnerable RTCP SDES Path (Internal IP & PII Leak)
1. Legacy user@host CNAME Bypasses TURN / mDNS Privacy
SDES CNAME: "voice-worker@10.24.8.12" (Sent every 5s!)
• Exposes internal Kubernetes Pod IPs and hostnames inside RTCP
• Static MAC-derived CNAME enables permanent cross-call tracking
2. Forbidden Non-CNAME PII Items (NAME / EMAIL / PHONE / PRIV)
SDES: NAME="Alice", EMAIL="a@bank.com", TOOL="PJSIP-2.10"
• Violates RFC 8834 §4.9 prohibition on non-CNAME SDES metadata
• Broadcasts employee PII & exact stack version to external peers
3. Unbounded 19-Chunk SDES Compound RTCP Bloat
19 SDES Chunks x 255B -> Starves 5% RTCP feedback budget
• Delays critical NACK, TWCC, and RR congestion reports
• Triggers UDP fragmentation on compound RTCP packets
✅ Deterministic RFC 7022 / 8834 Guardrails (P1029 + P1030 🎉)
P1029 (1,038th Guardrail): RFC 7022 Ephemeral Random CNAME
action: "rewrite_sdes_cname_with_rfc7022_per_session_random_token"
• Rewrites static user@host / MAC CNAMEs to CSPRNG random tokens
• clampedHostIpOrMacLeakedInSdesCnameCount = 0 (zero IP leaks)
• clampedSdesCnameAsciiByteLength in [16, 32] bytes
Policy: P1029-WEBRTC-RFC7022-SDES-CNAME-EPHEMERAL-RANDOMNESS-AND-HOST-IP-LEAK-GUARD
P1030 🎉 (85th Round, P1030, 160th FAQ & 960 Tests!): PII Strip
action: "strip_non_cname_sdes_pii_items_and_cap_sdes_chunks"
• Strips NAME, EMAIL, PHONE, LOC, TOOL, NOTE, and PRIV items
• clampedLeakedNonCnameSdesPiiItems = 0 (100% RFC 8834 §4.9 clean)
• clampedMaxSdesChunksPerCompoundRtcpPacket in [1, 8] chunks
Policy: P1030-WEBRTC-RFC8834-FORBIDDEN-NON-CNAME-SDES-ITEM-STRIP-AND-CHUNK-CAP-GUARD
PROVENANCE, TIMING DISCLOSURE & STAGE 518 BENCHMARK SCORECARD (521 DIMENSIONS · 1,039 GUARDRAILS · 1,048 PROBES · 960 TESTS 🎉)
Timing Disclosure: 0ms reported at nominal 1ms display resolution; actual duration unresolved/not_measured; no sub-1ms upper bound established
